title: 2018 HMMT November General Problem 2
statement: Twenty-seven players are randomly split into three teams of nine. Given that Zack is on a different team from Mihir and Mihir is on a different team from Andrew, what is the probability that Zack and Andrew are on the same team?

solutions.text:
Answer:

Once we have assigned Zack and Mihir teams, there are 8 spots for more players on Zack's team and 9 for more players on the third team. Andrew is equally likely to occupy any of these spots, so our answer is \(\frac{8}{17}\).
